project.name: arduhub-landing
project.productType: Educational Arduino learning dashboard for schoolchildren

must: Preserve ArduHub cream, green-black and amber palette and Inter/Manrope fonts.
Use existing real components and truthful progress from computeCourseState.
Use Russian content modules, 44px touch targets, reduced motion and only transform/opacity animation.
avoid: Invented learner progress, rankings, projects or unavailable product features.
Decorative gradients and unrelated visual redesigns.

decisions: 2026-11-10 latest user correction: login displays email and current password together immediately, with one sign-in submit button; no next-step email action. Registration remains progressive. Glass input text/placeholders gain 12px inline padding via scoped --signup-input-padding, preserving the visible logo/title and internal scrolling on short viewports.

2026-11-10 viewport correction: both login and registration now reuse the supplied glass step form. Login is email -> current password, preserving real credentials, errors, resend, recovery, guest and registration switch. Keep logo/title outside a bounded internal scroll area; card max-height follows 100dvh, compact spacing below 600px height, focus uses preventScroll. This prevents autofocus from scrolling the whole page and hiding the beginning. Backgrounds remain lossless with 5-second scene changes.

2026-11-10 supplied glass sign-up reference adapted in src/components/ui/sign-up.tsx: Russian email -> password -> confirmation/profile flow, glossy pill fields/arrow actions, translucent centered surface, real infinity brand mark + ArduHub. Existing AuthCard owns actual account requests, validation, roles, consent, guest entry and error handling. No demo success timers or unsupported OAuth buttons. Inter/Cobalt Mono retained. Latest explicit interval is 5 seconds per scene (15-second cycle). Backgrounds use lossless source-derived *-hq.webp, served unoptimized to avoid secondary lossy recompression; original resolution/pixels verified, no invented detail/upscaling.

2026-11-10 latest auth illustration correction: replace all seated desk scenes with varied full-body poses and a shared giant robot project. Three frames: mentors walking/fetching tools/pushing a parts trolley/Oma at the window; collaborative giant humanoid robot assembly with Shina on a step ladder and Rezik kneeling at wiring; first robot test with reaching/crouching/jumping poses. Keep the centered form and existing crossfade. Assets: mentor-tool-run.webp, mentor-giant-robot.webp, mentor-robot-test.webp. These are still illustrations, not animated walking footage.

2026-11-10 user correction supersedes split authentication layout: full-viewport background slideshow of three mentor workshop scenes, slow 2.2s crossfades every 12s, centered form on all widths. Remove workshop headings/captions, auth subtitles, role descriptions and duplicate login/register prompts. Retain essential labels, consent, parent guidance, recovery, guest entry and theme. Inter/Cobalt Mono retained. Reduced motion uses a static first image, hidden tabs pause, transitions start after all images load.

2026-11-09: explicit user request extends Cobalt Mono and local Inter to sign-in, registration and shared password-recovery shell. Reuse AuthCard with its existing auth behavior; coherent generated workshop illustration preserves all four existing mentor identities (Shina soldering, Rezik assembling Arduino, Oma observing, Volt waving). Wide screens use a sticky illustration beside the form; narrow screens show the complete workshop above it. Asset: public/images/auth/mentor-workshop.webp. Auth has scoped blue/white/lavender tokens and dark-theme equivalents; no glass button material.

G3 preserves the existing dashboard palette; thematic SVG icons use the flame, ice, spark and chip colors specified in docs/ArduHub_G3_motion_sound_icons.md. Event motion has bounded lifetimes and a reduced-motion alternative.

2026-11-08: public homepage only uses Cobalt Mono scoped tokens, local Inter/EB Garamond, transparent generated Arduino renders animated without cursor tracking; cabinet and auth retain existing styling. Neuralese reference guides motion and product storytelling, no copied media.

2026-11-08 user correction: apply Cobalt Mono reference with Inter for all landing text and headings, white background, cobalt actions and pale lavender surfaces. Remove editorial serif/italic styling. Preserve all existing animations, durations, phase delays and interactions. This supersedes the earlier serif choice.

2026-11-08 latest user instruction: compact Neuralese-inspired video-led structure, blue-to-white dot hero with no Arduino cutouts, own local recordings in rainbow/blue/pink/green video frames, four vivid benefit cards, FAQ and final CTA. Inter and Cobalt Mono retained. Prior long gallery/stats/steps/pricing layout superseded on homepage only.

2026-11-08 user reference Ludr: replace hero dots with continuously scrolling Arduino code and component names in pale grey-white and blue on the existing blue background. Columns alternate direction and speed; center is subdued for readability. Pause control, offscreen/hidden-tab pause and reduced-motion static fallback. Other sections unchanged.

2026-11-08 user correction: decorative hero code uses VT323; Cyrillic component names use pixel Tiny5 as glyph fallback. Both fonts are local WOFF2, scoped to homepage. Foreground typography remains Inter.
2026-11-08 latest user correction: component labels, including Latin names, use local Monocraft Regular v4.2.1; Arduino code remains VT323. Monocraft replaces Tiny5 on the homepage backdrop.

2026-11-08 explicit user request: remove all animation and video play/pause overlay buttons from homepage. Background and videos retain automatic visibility/tab/reduced-motion handling. No replacement overlay controls.

2026-11-08 explicit user request: apply the supplied Simey iridescent Glass Button material project-wide to native buttons, button-like links and controls. Shared glass-buttons.css owns pale rounded glass surfaces, inset highlights, soft shadows and cyan/violet hover lustre; preserve labels, dimensions, actions, state feedback, keyboard focus, reduced motion and forced colors. Supersedes earlier button palettes across landing/auth/cabinet; removed media overlay controls remain absent.

2026-11-08 scope correction: iridescent Glass Button styles apply ONLY inside the homepage .landing-video container. Remove global body marker/import; all other routes restore their existing button styling, including client-side navigation from homepage.

2026-11-08 clarified meaning of first page: Glass Button is ONLY for the first hero screen and public navbar, scoped to .landing-video :is(.hero, .header). Restore original controls in all lower landing sections (FAQ and final CTA included), auth, cabinet and other routes. Earlier whole-homepage scope was a misunderstanding.

2026-11-08 explicit user typography change: homepage hero headline uses local Spectral Medium 500 with real italic for the question word Заработает?. Other foreground text remains Inter; backdrop code/components remain VT323/Monocraft.

2026-11-08 user video reference: four benefit cards act as an expanding accordion. Desktop hover/focus/click widens one card and narrows neighbors; long copy and themed side art appear. <=1050px uses a vertical tap accordion. First card shows existing Arduino/LED assets, Arduino mark and Wokwi Elements word label; other cards show wiring, lesson stages, and project code. Respect reduced motion; no new media control buttons or claims of partnerships.

2026-11-08 correction: benefit cards start ALL closed, open on pointer hover and close on leave (mouse clicks must not latch them). Keyboard focus stays supported; touch taps toggle open/closed. Primary summary is never line-clamped or truncated. Unified 850ms material easing for width, details and side art; mobile collapsed height increased to fit all primary text.

2026-11-09 user Neuralese video: homepage navbar has no boxed surface, border, blur or shadow, including scrolled state. A full-width 160px blue-to-transparent top gradient sits behind links; deep blue/white links on hero, soft blue/dark links on scroll. Existing glass buttons and mobile dropdown retained. Scoped to landing-video.css.
